goals: Advance the accepted C6 compatibility layer to C7 while preserving its Inventory Extended player-storage, Clutter No More ShapeMap, vanilla shelf, and Inventory Search behavior.
Add optional Container Slot Reservations integration so an exact reserved item-and-component match can create QSN target affinity and reserved empty slots receive items before ordinary empty slots.

Keep Quick Stack Nearby responsible for discovery, target order, existing-stack merges, access and placement checks, capacity, remainders, rules, persistence, packets, and feedback; delegate unchanged when CSR is absent or a target has no reservation-governed empty slot.
Preserve exact accepted C6 and the distinct runtime-passed C4 rollback with their immutable artifact, source, and evidence boundaries.
scope: Maintain sixteen production Java classes and three production resources at implementation checkpoint 3f124a44086e52845e35805d5abb3049379150b8.
Augment QSN's discovered target list only when the optional public CSR API reports an exact item-and-component reservation match, retaining every original target object and order.

Intercept QSN 0.4.0's exact post-merge empty-slot seam only when an empty slot is governed by a matching or mismatched reservation; insert into matching reserved empties in physical order, then ordinary empties in physical order, while mismatched reserved empties remain protected.
Preserve exact no-op identity when CSR is absent and delegate QSN's native empty-slot helper for unsupported or wholly unreserved targets.

Retain C6's Inventory Extended source-window expansion and lock ceiling, Clutter No More ShapeMap affinity and merge delegation, vanilla shelf exclusion, and Inventory Search button/result compatibility.
Audit exact QSN 0.4.0 and CSR C1 bytecode/API seams, exercise the CSR C1 API floor and retained CSR C2 provider pair, and keep runtime metadata predicates flexible for compatible providers.
Retain exact C4 as the distinct focused-runtime-pass rollback and preserve the failed C5 result textually rather than as a current or rollback artifact.

exclusions: Container Slot Reservations, Carried Container Auto-Routing, Matcha × Stack to Nearby Chests Compatibility, Inventory Search, Block Geometry Extensions, Nibaru, Clutter No More, Quick Stack Nearby, and every other nearby-routing or inventory project retain their own identities, source, artifacts, controls, and behavior ownership.

No CSR reservation mutation, persistence, user interface, container-support policy, or classification logic is reimplemented; C7 consumes only CSR's public read-only reservation API when the provider is loaded.

No Stack to Nearby Chests implementation, Matcha-specific QSN adapter, general Inventory Search patch, carried-container routing, nested-container routing, registry-name parsing, fuzzy material equivalence, item conversion, or custom existing-stack merge is owned here.
Official QSN, CSR, Inventory Search/Core, Inventory Extended, Clutter No More, BGE, Nibaru, Minecraft, and Fabric classes or JARs are not bundled or redistributed by this project.

C7 mirrors the exact audited QSN 0.4.0 package-private maximum-stack helper through its current Container#getMaxStackSize delegate because attempted Java-package and Mixin invokers were not runtime-safe; a future QSN helper change requires seam re-audit.
Controlled JUnit and Fabric GameTest results are build/static evidence, not Minecraft gameplay runtime validation.

Lifecycle remains TESTING because exact current C7 occupies Test Slot B at manager revision 71 with its own UNTESTED result; C6's historical accepted aggregate pass remains separate and is not assigned to C7.

This checkpoint records only the serialized, physically verified Test Instance Manager deployment. Minecraft was not launched, no runtime result was inferred, accepted C6 and rollback C4 were not promoted or replaced, and the protected gameplay instance remained untouched.
